units.source_text: 我心里一直惦记着刚才那件事，

en.t: The matter from a moment before kept weighing on my mind,
like a fishbone caught in my throat that I had to spit out,

units.source_text: 想对先生直说，又觉得还是不说的好。

en.t: I wanted to speak frankly to Sensei, yet felt it would be better not to say anything.

units.source_text: 这么左思右想的，显得心神不定。

en.t: As I turned it over and over in my mind, I must have seemed restless.

units.source_text: “你今天晚上有点儿不对劲啊，”先生发问，

en.t: “You seem a little unlike yourself tonight,” Sensei said,

units.source_text: “其实我也有点儿反常，你看出来了吗？”

en.t: “To tell the truth, I am a little strange myself. Did you notice?”
I did not know how to answer.

units.source_text: “是这样，刚才我和妻子拌了两句嘴，

en.t: “The truth is, I had a little quarrel with my wife just now,

units.source_text: 使得我这无聊的神经兴奋起来了。”先生又说。

en.t: and it stirred up these foolish nerves of mine,” Sensei added.

units.source_text: “为什么……”我没说出“吵架”这个词来。

en.t: “Why...” I could not bring myself to say the word “quarrel.”

units.source_text: 我告诉她是个误会，她还是不肯罢休，

en.t: I told her it was a misunderstanding, but she still would not let it go,
“In what way has your wife misunderstood you?”

units.source_text: 先生根本没想回答我的问题。

en.t: Sensei had no intention at all of answering my question.

units.source_text: “我要是她想象的那样的人，就不会这么痛苦了。”

en.t: “If I were the sort of man she imagines, I would not be suffering like this.”

units.source_text: 先生究竟有多么痛苦，也是我无法想象的问题。

en.t: How deeply Sensei was suffering was also something beyond my imagination.
